description: Hand in a finished job: the plan, your own log, its last entry, the job's one-time number and the agent's own report (see the input schema). The job's start must already be sealed under the same Knox key. Knox compares them and seals the result (one stamp on your plan). A second return of the same job is refused. If the job started with knox_record by_step or by_count, Knox also compares your own log and the agent's report with the yes answers Knox itself gave during the job; that setting is sealed when the job starts, and a return cannot choose it. The compare is against your own log, not against what the outside system did, and it is only as complete as that record. Knox never holds your job's key; check the record yourself with the published checker. Send your Knox key as a Bearer token.

departure_seal.description: The stamp code of the trip's agent_trip_departed, sealed under your key before the agent's first action.

door_head.description: The hash of the door's last observation (64 zeros for an empty record).

flow.description: Optional. "bsa" when the trip ran in a BSA flow; the departure must say the same. Only such trips can enter the examiner pack.

folders.description: Optional. For each work folder the departure sealed ({label, root, files}): {label, before: [{path, size, sha256}], after: [...]}, made on your own machine (public/legal-kit/knox-folder-manifest.mjs). Knox checks the before list rebuilds the sealed root and flags every change the report does not name. Knox never reads a file.

keyed_check.description: Optional. What your own keyed check of this log found: {result: "passed" | "failed", value?}. value is 64 hex: HMAC-SHA-256 with the job's key over "knox-keyed-check/1|nonce|planHash|door_head|number of lines". Knox does not hold the key and cannot run this check; it records what you report, as your report. "failed" marks the job as not matching. Left out, the result says the keyed check was not reported.

nonce.description: The trip nonce held by your door. Knox checks it against the nonce hash sealed at departure; it is not stored.

observations.description: The door's record, in order: [{seq, tool, kind, ref, argsCommit, resultCommit, outcome, reason, at, prevHash, hash, mac, amounts?}]. Targets and keyed commitments, never content. amounts is optional: {attribute: number}, the amount your own systems recorded as sent, on the line that says how the step ended, under the same attribute names your gateway reports to Knox. It must be inside what the line's hash covers. A line without it is never compared on amount.

plan.description: The flight plan, as sealed at departure: [{tool, ref, max?, optional?}].

report.description: What the agent says it did: {actions?: [{tool, ref}], claimedKinds?: [kind], effects?: [{kind, ref, hash}], files?: [{folder, path, change: added|changed|removed}]}, or null when it never reported back.

name: return_agent_trip
